content.text: Mahanaim -- i.e. two hosts, or bands -- the visible band, Jacob and his servants; the invisible band, God's angels. Cf. 2 Kings 6:13-17.
Edom -- i.e. Esau's country. Genesis 25:30. (See Scofield "Genesis 36:1").
and there wrestled -- Jacob's crisis. Cf. Joshua 5:13-15; Job 42:5,6; Isaiah 6:1-8; Jeremiah 1:4-9; Ezekiel 1:28; 2:1-7; Daniel 10:1-12; Acts 9:1-6; Revelation 1:13-18.

shall be no more called Jacob -- Both names are applied to the nation descended from Jacob. When used characteristically "Jacob" is the name for the natural posterity of Abraham, Isaac, and Jacob; "Israel" for the spiritual part of the nation. See Isaiah 9:8. The "word" was sent to all the people, "Jacob," but it "lighted upon Israel," i.e. was comprehended by the spiritual part of the people. See "Israel" Genesis 12:2,3.

(See Scofield "Romans 11:26").
